posts.title: AALF 2026: the 15th All African Leather Fair
posts.excerpt: 12–15 November 2026 at the Addis International Convention Center, held alongside the 12th ASFW Addis. Manufacturers, buyers, brands, investors and innovators under one roof.

posts.title: All African Leather Fair (AALF)
posts.excerpt: The trade show organised by the Ethiopian Leather Industries Association (ELIA) from the first edition in 2008 up to the 12th, successfully. AALF brings together tanners, footwear and other leather goods manufacturers, in addition to equipment and technology suppliers, chemical and inputs suppliers, manpower training institutions, trade promotion organizations, etc. from all over the world.

posts.title: Filming a video for Ethiopian Highland Leather
posts.excerpt: The Ethiopia Industrial Promotion Project (Export Promotion) (Phase 2) aims to increase the export revenue of leather products, and has supported the launch of Ethiopian Highland Leather (EHL), a national brand of sheepskin materials, and strengthened its brand management. One of its activities is the production of a promotional video for EHL.
